drugs.name: Caffeine
drugs.summary: Blocks adenosine receptors, so the heart's natural braking signal is weakened.

effects.note: More forceful contraction in some people.
Peripheral vessels can narrow while other beds dilate.

drugs.name: Beta-blocker
drugs.summary: Blocks beta-1 receptors on the heart so sympathetic signals have less effect.

effects.note: Output falls, so pressure usually falls too.

drugs.name: Nitrate
drugs.summary: Releases nitric oxide, relaxing vascular smooth muscle, especially in veins.

effects.note: Lower filling pressure means less work for the heart.
A reflex response can raise the rate.

drugs.name: Atropine
drugs.summary: Blocks vagal input to the SA and AV nodes.
